source.title: Do jewelcrafting get better with more points into prospecting?
source.author: P_Griffin2

quote: Leveling the prospecting tree gives you a chance for 2 gems whenever you would have otherwise gotten 1.
notes: Firsthand but unmeasured claim: max/last Prospecting talent can grant a second gem on a gem-producing cast. Same author later says 'Feels like 50%'—subjective, not a sampled hit rate. OldWolf2 independently comments last Prospecting point increases gem output. Exact ore and material rank IDs, casts, skill, specialization allocation, 0/1/2 histogram, input quantities, refund, date/build not provided. Reference only, no estimator sample.
specialization: Prospecting tree investment; exact last-node points not provided
